column1: # Test groups that do not pass in the browser build, and why (first written
# 05/10/2026, test/trunk r13248).  category<TAB>group<TAB>what the log shows
#   processes   the test runs an external command (rexx, rexxc, rxqueue,
#               rxsubcom, sh, echo, id...): a browser has no processes, so
#               ADDRESS to a shell/command environment ends with RC 127
#   install     .RexxInfo~executable is .nil in the browser: the executable
#               (rexx.wasm) comes from a URL, not from the program's file
#               system, so there is no File for it (libraryPath is
#   test-bug    the test group itself is wrong: json_02/yaml failed when
#               executable is .nil (bug #2097, fixed in test/trunk r13249);
#               DateTime expects "0:00am" to be valid, which trunk r13250
#   api-libs    needs the native test libraries (orxclassic, orxmethod...),
#               not built for WASM (as under Node)
#   sockets     RxSock in the browser goes over WebSockets: no listening
#   stack       recursion depth bounded by the engine's native stack (Error 11
#               is raised cleanly; the test wants >= 5000 levels)
#   memfs       Emscripten's MEMFS: stat() goes through a JS Date, so file
#               times read back in whole milliseconds (like FAT, which the
#   flaky       intermittent, passes when rerun (timing between threads)
#   upstream    ooRexx itself (not the port): see notes

column3: TEST_EXTERNAL_CALLS: RC 127 for an external command
external command raises FAILURE (RC 127), test expects ERROR
searchPath("sh"): no shell on PATH; *_FRACTIONS: MEMFS file times read back in whole ms
shell commands (cd, exit, cat, sort...) RC 127
server/client tests (no listen) and socket options (.nil)
TEST_STACKSIZE: Error 11 at ~900 (Chromium), ~1300 (Firefox) levels; WebKit passes (~5000) or not (3614 with the WebKit of the GitHub runners): it depends on the engine build
hangs at interpreter termination under load, as natively (todo 10)
TEST_TRACE_LABEL_WITH_FORWARD: trace line count depends on thread timing (also seen under Node)

TEST_FROMCIVILTIME uses "0:00am", which TIME()/DateTime reject since trunk r13250 (as TIME.testGroup itself expects: 40.19 for "00:00am"): 1 error on every platform, native too. Also, WebKit only: occasionally no output after "Executing automated test suite"; passes when retried
TEST_REXXINFO_EXECUTABLE: executable expected to be a File (it is .nil)
init: filespec('location', .rexxInfo~executable) with executable .nil; no test runs (227 pass with the fix); bug #2097, fixed in test/trunk r13249
same as json_02 (54 pass with the fix); bug #2097, fixed in test/trunk r13249
the samples are run as a rexx process (and are not in the browser's file system)
TEST_INTERPRETER_THREAD_INVOCATION: compares with a value a START thread records, read before that thread wrote it (".nil"); once in Chromium (r13254 run), 6 reruns pass
TEST_INTEGER_TIME with TZ=UTC: on 32-bit builds (wasm32) TIME('O') is a String, never a RexxInteger; the test expects one when the offset is 0. Any other time zone passes
